start_start: Hi, I am musiCal Bot. I offer you some tools that can be useful for your music creation process! Send me /help to know more.
start_name: Please tell me your artistic name. We are going to be a good team!
start_ts: What is your favorite time signature for writing music?
start_error: Try again. I didn't understand that. Send me numbers separated with /. For example 3/4 or 2/8.
start_end: That's all. I am ready! Waiting for commands...
pcs_start: From now on you can send me your pitch sets separating each note (0-11) with spaces. Send me an invented command to terminate (/shutup).
pcs_info: The notes you have sent correspond to the following pitch class set: SET.Z_PAIRThere are STATES different states for this set. -Ordered form: ORDERED_FORM -Prime form: PRIME_FORM -Interval vector: INTERVAL_VECTOR
pcs_zpair: Its Z related set is the SET.
pcs_pcserror: I couldn't find any prime form after ordering your notes. Is there a mistake?
pcs_nerror: Be careful! I need you to send me a list of numbers separated with spaces.
allstates_start: From now on you can send me a pitch set separating each note (0-11) with spaces. I will send you all possible states for that set. Send me an invented command to terminate (/enough).
allstates_msg: Here are all states for the set you just sent:
allstates_error: I couldn't build the list of states for that set. Check your message please! Remember not to repeat the notes.
chain_start: From now on you can send me your pitch sets separating each note (0-11) with spaces. I will try to creat a constant pitch class set notes sequence. You can send me h asking for help. Send me an invented command to terminate (/shutup).
chain_new: The notes you sent me correspond to the SET_DATA pitch class set. I could create aSTATE notes sequence with them. Here are the notes:
chain_op: I applied the requested operation. Now your chain looks like this:
chain_operror: I couldn't apply any operation. Check your message please.
chain_nerror: I couldn't nor create a sequence with your notes neither apply an operation to a sequence which doesn't exist. Send me h if you want help.
chain_help: You can send me a set of notes separated by spaces (0-11). If you send me 0 1 5 8 10 I will try to create a chain with C C# F G# Bb. Send me n if you want a new chain with the same notes. Send me +n (where n is a natural number) if you want a last chain translation. Send me xn (where n is a whole number) if you want to multiply the elements of your chain. Send me i if you want to invert your chain. Send me c if you want me to extend your chain until is closed. Send me and invented command to terminate (/bye). Send me h to fall in an infinite loop.
matrix_start: Let's create a matrix together. First use a button to let me know which matrix you want. Send me h if you need help.
matrix_success: I created a matrix following your instruccions. Now you can operate it. You can send me p to print your current matrix state or f to receive a text file with your operations history.
matrix_button: I apreciate your message but I am trying to build a new matrix and I need you to click a button...
matrix_selection_1: To build a Type 1 matrix I will need a pitch class set.
matrix_selection_2: To build a Type 2 matrix I will need, one by one, two pitch class sets.
matrix_selection_3: To build a Chain matrix I will need a closed chain. You can use one of the chains you made with the /chain command.
matrix_selection_4: I need two different inputs to build a translation cycle matrix.
matrix_set1: Send me a list of notes separated with spaces (0-11).
matrix_set2: Send me another list of notes.
matrix_chain: Send me a closed chain separating each link with - (0 1 2-3 4-0 1 2).
matrix_cyclerow: Send me the first row of your matrix separating each cell with - (like: 0 1-2 3--5).
matrix_cycledistance: Send me your desired transposition value (I need a number).
matrix_header:
Starting new matrix history file...
This file will be overwritten each time you run /matrix command...
matrix_filecaption: A text file which contains your current matrix and all the operations you applied to it.
matrix_fileerror: I couldn't find any matrix history file. Nothing to send...
matrix_op: I applied the requested operation succesfully. The matrix was updated.
matrix_operror: I couldn't apply any operation. Check your message.
matrix_state: Here is the current state of your matrix:
matrix_file: Here is a file with all applied operations since the moment you created the matrix:
matrix_help: All starts with a button to let me know which matrix type you want. I will ask for the data I need to build one. After that, If I could create the matrix, you can operate it. Send me n to create a new matrix. Send me r to shuffle your matrix. Send me +n (where n is a natural number) to translate your matrix. Send me xn (where n is a whole number) to multiply your matrix. Send me i to invert your matrix. Send me t to transpose your matrix. Send me s to run a random swapping round in your matrix. Send me p to see the current state of your matrix or f to receive a text file with your operations history. Send me and invented command to terminate (/theend). Send me h to fall in an infinite loop.
matrix_error: Something went wrong. Send me h if you need help.
random_size: I love uncertainty! Let's create some random sequences. How long should the sequences be? Tell me a number.
random_dice: How many faces do you want our imaginary dice to have?
random_distribution: Ok. Use the buttons to choose a probability distribution. You can also send me a text message to shuffle. Send me and invented command to terminate (/shutup).
random_list: I need a list of things separated by spaces. I will choose them randomly.
random_error: I didn't understand that! Send me a number.
random_keyboard: A dice,Minor of two,Sum of two,Sum of three,With list
music_t: Let's create a brief piece of music. Tell me a good title.
music_c_m: Select a counterpoint mode. Random (1), with pitch list (2) or markov table (3).
music_c_d: Send me your data if need. A greeting otherwise.
music_c: I created a fantastic musical moment.
language_warning: If the bot is restarted perhaps will be forget your preference. In that case, be patient and send /language again.
language_end: I will try speak in english now.
submit_error_command: Please tell me which command the error you are reporting is related to.
submit_error_about: Tell me briefly what the error you found is about.
submit_error_end: Thank you so much for taking a minute to make me better. Hopefully @rvalla will fix me soon.
error: Something went wrong... I am so sorry!
admin: New admin session started. Here are the available sudo buttons:
admin_end: The time passed. Admin session was aborted.
intruder: This is a secret command. You are not authorized to use it.
privacy: Don't worry! I only save essential data (such as your artistic name or language preference). I don't even remember your username (I link your data to this chat id).
help_1:
You can ask me for different things. Here is a list with the available commands:

> Send me /pcs to start a pitch class set analysis sesion (note that I understand numbers (0-11)).
> Send me /allstates to get all states for a pitch class set.
> Send me /chain to start a constant pitch class set sequence creation session.
> Send me /matrix to build and operate with matrices.
> Send me /random to get random sequences.
> Send me /error to report any error you find on me.
> Send me /language to decide in which language I speak to you.
help_2: Suscribe to @caltools channel to find out how I evolve (in spanish). If you have any doubts, complaints or questions you can write to @rvalla (he's the one to blame for everything). You can also visit the musiCal project website.
